leadText:
This is the 12th chapter of the Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master! manga. It was first published in the February 2023 issue of CoroCoro Ichiban!, released on December 21, 2022. It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on November 27, 2023.
